_comment: SHA-256 of every corrected envelope fixture as machina-sports-canonical 0.1.0 produced it,
captured from the checked-in bytes at commit 08d62ef before any RFC 002 §12 edit.
WHY A DIGEST RATHER THAN A SECOND COPY OF EACH FIXTURE. RFC 002 §12 requires the
exact-observation diff to be an ENUMERATED diff — 'any diff outside the enumerated items is a
regression, not a version artifact' — which is a claim about every other byte in the envelope.
tests/test_iptc_temporal_evidence.py rebuilds each envelope, mechanically undoes exactly the
enumerated version-bearing changes, reserializes with the writer the fixtures are checked in
with, and compares the digest against the row here. A match proves byte identity of
sport_schema_graph, event_view, provenance, provider_ids and rights across the bump, for every
fixture, in 8 checked-in lines instead of 160 KB of duplicated JSON that would rot.
THESE ROWS ARE HISTORY AND ARE NEVER REGENERATED. They record what 0.1.0 emitted. If a row
stops matching, the answer is that something outside the enumerated diff changed — which is
the finding, not a stale file. Re-recording a row would delete the only evidence of it.
